1330101.name: Uproar of Decibels
1330101.desc: All squad members' <color=#CF4029>Energy Generation Rate is reduced by 15%</color>, while <color=#2BAD00>Decibel Generation Rate is increased by 25%</color>.

1330201.name: Overlocked Dexterity Mode
1330201.desc: All squad members' <color=#2BAD00>ATK increases by 30%</color> and <color=#2BAD00>CRIT DMG increases by 40%</color>. When taking DMG and losing HP, <color=#CF4029>this buff is removed</color>. Effect is reset upon entering the next area.

1330301.name: Face of Chaos and Anomalies
1330301.desc: All squad members' <color=#CF4029>ATK is reduced by 15%</color>. When Stunning or inflicting Attribute Anomaly on enemies, all squad members' <color=#2BAD00>CRIT DMG is increased by 40%</color>, and <color=#2BAD00>Anomaly Proficiency is increased by 40</color> for 20s.

1330401.name: Will to Overcome Adversity
1330401.desc:
When the Agent's HP is above 80%, <color=#CF4029>DMG dealt decreases by 40%</color>.
When HP is below 50%, <color=#2BAD00>DMG dealt increases by 40%</color>.
When HP is below 20%, <color=#2BAD00>CRIT Rate increases by an additional 15%</color> and <color=#2BAD00>CRIT DMG increases by an additional 30%</color>.

1331001.name: Nitro-Fuel Sharing Pack
1331001.desc: Agents <color=#CF4029>take 20% increased DMG</color>, but no longer consume <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Points</color> when activating <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Evasive Assist</color>.

1339701.name: Navigation Data Set
1339701.desc: Gain <color=#2BAD00>3</color> Navigation Data, which can be used to <color=#2BAD00>reset navigation</color> at Friendly Talk with Marlene.

1339702.name: Locator Card: Finance
1339702.desc: You can perform <color=#2BAD00>1 Oriented Iteration</color> with Marlene in Friendly Talk to refresh the map to an area map that is <color=#2BAD00>related to Gear Coins</color>.

1339703.name: Locator Card: Shortcut
1339703.desc: You can perform <color=#2BAD00>1 Oriented Iteration</color> with Marlene in Friendly Talk to refresh the map to an area map with the <color=#2BAD00>shortest route</color>.

1339704.name: Locator Card: Power
1339704.desc: You can perform <color=#2BAD00>1 Oriented Iteration</color> with Marlene in Friendly Talk to refresh the map to an area map <color=#2BAD00>related to Challenge</color>.

For every Mist area entered in the current Hollow, all squad members' ATK increases by <color=#2BAD00>10%</color>, <color=#2BAD00>CRIT DMG increases by 20%</color>, and Anomaly Proficiency increases by <color=#2BAD00>20</color>.

1339708.name: Locator Card: Finance
1339708.desc: You can perform <color=#2BAD00>1 Oriented Iteration</color> with Marlene in Friendly Talk to refresh the map to an area map that is <color=#2BAD00>related to Gear Coins</color>.

1339709.desc: You can perform <color=#2BAD00>1 Oriented Iteration</color> with Marlene in Friendly Talk to refresh the map to an area map with the <color=#2BAD00>shortest route</color>.

1339710.desc: You can perform <color=#2BAD00>1 Oriented Iteration</color> with Marlene in Friendly Talk to refresh the map to an area map <color=#2BAD00>related to Challenge</color>.

1339711.desc: You can perform <color=#2BAD00>1 Oriented Iteration</color> with Marlene in Friendly Talk to refresh the map to an area map <color=#2BAD00>related to Price Difference</color>.

1339713.name: Locator Card: Mist Breaker
1339713.desc:
You can perform <color=#2BAD00>1 Oriented Iteration</color> with Marlene in Friendly Talk to refresh the map to one with <color=#2BAD00>Mist</color> areas.
For every Mist area entered in the current Hollow, all squad members' ATK increases by <color=#2BAD00>10%</color>, <color=#2BAD00>CRIT DMG increases by 20%</color>, and Anomaly Proficiency increases by <color=#2BAD00>20</color>.

1339751.name: Locator Card: Index
1339751.desc: The mercenary captain accidentally sent map data to the kind rescuers. You can perform <color=#2BAD00>1 Oriented Iteration</color> with Marlene in Friendly Talk to refresh the map to the <color=#2BAD00>specified map</color>.

1339801.name: Foggy Accounting
1339801.desc: When leaving a Bangboo Store, <color=#CF4029>all current Gear Coins will be cleared</color>. For every 100 Gear Coins spent on artifacts, enemies (except bosses) will have their HP reduced by <color=#2BAD00>0.5%</color> (up to 30%).

1339802.name: Reckless Warrior
1339802.desc: When current HP <color=#CF4029>exceeds 10% of Max HP, it will be reduced to 10%</color>. <color=#CF4029>All squad members take 50% more DMG</color>, but <color=#2BAD00>attacks are guaranteed to trigger critical hits, ATK increases by 100%, and Anomaly Proficiency increases by 400</color>.

1339803.name: Law of Tides
1339803.desc: Agents <color=#2BAD00>restore HP to all squad members</color> based on DMG dealt.

1339804.name: Fearless Flame
1339804.desc: Upon entering each Mist area in the current Hollow, <color=#2BAD00>all squad members' ATK increases by 5%, CRIT DMG increases by 5%, and Anomaly Proficiency increases by 10</color>.

1339805.name: Bribe Attack: Enhanced
1339805.desc: For every 100 Gear Coins owned, <color=#2BAD00>all squad members' DMG dealt increases by 1%, CRIT Rate increases by 0.5%, CRIT DMG increases by 1%, and Anomaly Proficiency increases by 2</color>.

1339806.name: Patchwork Defense
1339806.desc: For every non-combat area entered in the current Hollow, enemies deal <color=#2BAD00>2.5%</color> less DMG to Agents. This effect can be triggered up to <color=#2BAD00>6</color> times.

1339807.name: Trace of an Old Friend
1339807.desc: Each time you enter a non-combat area, gain <color=#2BAD00>200</color> Gear Coins.

1339808.name: Electrostatic Phenomenon
1339808.desc: When entering a non-combat area, all squad members' CRIT Rate increases by <color=#2BAD00>2%</color> while in this Hollow.

1339809.name: Patchwork Defense
1339809.desc: For every non-combat area entered in the current Hollow, enemies deal <color=#2BAD00>2.5%</color> less DMG to Agents. This effect can be triggered up to <color=#2BAD00>6</color> times.

1339810.name: Trace of an Old Friend
1339810.desc: Each time you enter a non-combat area, gain <color=#2BAD00>200</color> Gear Coins.

1339811.name: Electrostatic Phenomenon
1339811.desc: When entering a non-combat area, all squad members' CRIT Rate increases by <color=#2BAD00>2%</color> while in this Hollow.

1339813.name: Initial Barrier (Disordered)
1339813.desc: When entering battle, <color=#FFAF2C>allies</color> gain a Shield equal to 10% of their Max HP.

1339814.name: Adrenaline (Risky)
1339814.desc: When HP drops below 50%, increase DMG by 20%

1339815.name: Opening Thunderstrike
1339815.desc: <color=#FFAF2C>Agents</color> lose 75% of their Max HP on the field.

1339816.name: Triple Buffering (Disordered)
1339816.desc: After entering the Boss Domain, the Boss enemy will take 50% less DMG for 20s.

1339817.name: "Immovable Mountain" Marathon
1339817.desc: After passing through <color=#FFAF2C>5 areas</color>, if you get launched no more than <color=#FFAF2C>5 times</color> (total times) along the way, you'll receive a <color=#FFAF2C>Tactical Prism Program upgrade</color>. Challenge progress can be viewed in the Collectibles interface.

1339818.name: "Stingy" Marathon
1339818.desc: After passing through <color=#FFAF2C>5 areas</color>, if you <color=#FFAF2C>didn't spend Gear Coins to buy products in the Store</color> along the way, you'll receive a <color=#FFAF2C>Tactical Prism Program upgrade</color>. Challenge progress can be viewed in the Collectibles interface.

1339819.name: "Mortal Form" Marathon
1339819.desc: After passing through <color=#FFAF2C>8 areas</color>, if you <color=#FFAF2C>obtained 1 General Resonium</color> along the way, you'll receive a <color=#FFAF2C>Tactical Prism Program upgrade</color>. Challenge progress can be viewed in the Collectibles interface.

1339820.name: "Money to Burn" Marathon
1339820.desc: After passing through <color=#FFAF2C>8 areas</color>, if you <color=#FFAF2C>consumed at least 500 Gear Coins</color> along the way, you'll receive a <color=#FFAF2C>Tactical Prism Program upgrade</color>. Challenge progress can be viewed in the Collectibles interface.

1339821.name: "Run With the Wind" Marathon
1339821.desc: After passing through <color=#FFAF2C>5 areas</color>, if your <color=#FFAF2C>time spent is less than 300s (based on stage time)</color> along the way, you'll receive a <color=#FFAF2C>Tactical Prism Program upgrade</color>. Challenge progress can be viewed in the Collectibles interface.

1339822.name: "Principles of Semiotics" Marathon
1339822.desc: After passing through <color=#FFAF2C>8 areas</color>, if you <color=#FFAF2C>experienced at least 1 Encounter</color> along the way, you'll receive a <color=#FFAF2C>Tactical Prism Program upgrade</color>. Challenge progress can be viewed in the Collectibles interface.

1339823.name: Reckless Warrior: Enhanced Version
1339823.desc: If current HP <color=#CF4029>exceeds 30% of Max HP, it is reduced to 30%</color>, and <color=#CF4029>the whole squad takes 50% more DMG</color>, though <color=#2BAD00>attacks are guaranteed to trigger CRITs. Additionally, their ATK increases by 100%, Sheer DMG by 50%, and Anomaly Proficiency by 400</color>. Any excess CRIT Rate will also be converted to CRIT DMG at a certain ratio, up to 150%.

1339825.name: Bribe Attack: Super Enhanced Edition
1339825.desc: For every 100 Gear Coins owned, <color=#2BAD00>all squad member's DMG increases by 1.5%, CRIT Rate increases by 0.5%, CRIT DMG increases by 1.5%, and Anomaly Proficiency increases by 3</color>.

1339826.name: The Great Monopoly: Mutated Version
1339826.desc: When obtaining Gear Coins, there is a 20% chance to gain an additional <color=#2BAD00>300%</color>, 20% chance to gain an additional <color=#2BAD00>150%</color>, 25% chance to gain an additional <color=#2BAD00>50%</color>, 25% chance the Gear Coins obtained remain unchanged, 5% chance to lose <color=#CF4029>10%</color> of all currently held Gear Coins, and 5% chance to lose <color=#CF4029>20%</color> of all currently held Gear Coins.

1339827.name: Fearless Flame - Enhanced Version
1339827.desc: Upon entering each Mist area in the current Hollow, <color=#2BAD00>all squad members' ATK increases by 5%, CRIT DMG increases by 10%, and Anomaly Proficiency increases by 20, and Sheer DMG increases by 2.5%</color>.

1339828.name: Stingy - Enhanced Version
1339828.desc: When entering a Bangboo Store, if no purchase is made, you will receive <color=#2BAD00>40%</color> of Gear Coins upon leaving the store.

1339902.name: The Great Monopoly
1339902.desc: When obtaining Gear Coins, there is a 40% chance of <color=#2BAD00>gaining an additional 20%</color>, a 5% chance of <color=#2BAD00>gaining an additional 50%</color>, and a 5% chance of reducing the number of Gear Coins that you receive this time <color=#CF4029>to 1</color>.

1339904.name: Bribe Attack
1339904.desc: <color=#2BAD00>DMG dealt by all squad members increases by 1%</color> for every 100 Gear Coins you have.

1339905.name: Profit Craft
1339905.desc: Immediately gain a number of Gear Coins equal to <color=#2BAD00>30%</color> of your current Gear Coins.

1339906.name: Genuine Gift
1339906.desc: When entering a Bangboo Store, there is a <color=#2BAD00>10%</color> chance to obtain <color=#2BAD00>2</color> free items, but the store cannot be refreshed.

1339907.name: Stingy
1339907.desc: When entering a Bangboo Store, if no purchase is made, you will receive <color=#2BAD00>20%</color> of Gear Coins upon leaving the store.

1339908.name: VIP Treatment
1339908.desc: Obtain <color=#2BAD00>5</color> Resonium Converter refresh chances. In Task Force Investigation, Resonium Converter can be used to refresh Tactical Prism Programs too.

1339909.name: Resolute Determination
1339909.desc: When completing a Combat area without taking damage, all squad members' DMG is increased by <color=#2BAD00>5%</color> while in the current Hollow.

1339910.name: Double-Sided Armor
1339910.desc: When entering a Combat area, all squad members lose <color=#CF4029>20%</color> of their current HP, gain <color=#2BAD00>10%</color> Max HP, and receive a shield equal to <color=#2BAD00>10%</color> of their Max HP. This effect can be triggered up to <color=#2BAD00>4</color> times in the current Hollow.

1339911.name: Patchwork Defense
1339911.desc: For every non-combat area entered in the current Hollow, enemies deal <color=#2BAD00>2.5%</color> less DMG to Agents. This effect can be triggered up to <color=#2BAD00>6</color> times.

1339912.name: Trace of an Old Friend
1339912.desc: Each time you enter a non-combat area, gain <color=#2BAD00>200</color> Gear Coins.

1339913.name: Electrostatic Phenomenon
1339913.desc: When entering a non-combat area, all squad members' CRIT Rate increases by <color=#2BAD00>2%</color> while in this Hollow.

1339914.name: Experimental Byproduct
1339914.desc: Take this card into <color=#2BAD00>Price Difference</color> to trigger unexpected effects.

1339921.name: Seal of Plundered Blood
1339921.desc: The Agent's <color=#CF4029>Max HP is reduced by 30%</color> in {CReplaceCardParam:ProgressLeft,1,2} combat areas.

1339922.name: Seal of Thorny Shackles
1339922.desc: Triggering <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> <color=#CF4029>consumes 4% HP</color> for the next {CReplaceCardParam:ProgressLeft,1,2} combat areas.

1339923.name: Seal of Concealment
1339923.desc: In {CReplaceCardParam:ProgressLeft,1,2} combat areas, <color=#CF4029>golden and red flash prompts will no longer appear</color> when enemies attack.

1339924.name: Seal of Malevolent Pursuit
1339924.desc: In {CReplaceCardParam:ProgressLeft,1,2} combat areas, <color=#CF4029>DMG taken by Agents is increased by 30%</color>.

1339925.name: Seal of Revelation
1339925.desc: In {CReplaceCardParam:ProgressLeft,1,2} combat areas, enemy <color=#CF4029>attacks have a chance to trigger a critical hit</color>.

1339926.name: Seal of Anomalous Secrecy
1339926.desc: In {CReplaceCardParam:ProgressLeft,1,2} combat areas, enemy <color=#CF4029>Anomaly Buildup RES increased by 50%</color>.

1339927.name: Seal of Enemy Fortitude
1339927.desc: In {CReplaceCardParam:ProgressLeft,1,2} combat areas, enemy <color=#CF4029>Daze recovery speed is increased by 35%</color>.

1339930.name: Seal of Bright Awakening
1339930.desc: <color=#2BAD00>Daze inflicted by <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assists</color> is increased by 40%</color>. <color=#2BAD00>DMG dealt by <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Ups</color> is increased by 80%.</color>

1339933.name: Seal of Abnormal Breakthrough
1339933.desc: <color=#2BAD00>Increases Agent DMG dealt from Attribute Anomaly by 50%</color>.

1339934.name: Seal of the Stunned Hunter
1339934.desc: <color=#2BAD00>Increases Agent DMG dealt to Stunned enemies by 50%</color>.
